turns.speaker: Operator
turns.text: Operator: Good afternoon. Welcome to the second quarter call.

turns.speaker: Chief Financial Officer
turns.text:
Chief Financial Officer: Revenue was a record, up 56% year over year. Data center revenue grew
sequentially, and gross margin was 72.4%.

turns.speaker: Chief Executive Officer
turns.text: Chief Executive Officer: Demand is extraordinary. We are sold out through next year.

turns.speaker: Analyst One
turns.text: Analyst One: Can you talk about supply?

turns.speaker: Chief Executive Officer
turns.text: Chief Executive Officer: Supply is improving every quarter.
